name: 75216 · Dallas, TX
findings: ZIP 75216 (Dallas) has 180 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (64% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75216 (Dallas) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
